data.exact_reserve_text: The Syndicate has applied a consistent approach to prior years in establishing the technical provisions for claims outstanding and reinsurers share thereof. Included within net claims incurred is adverse prior year development relating to certain financial lines classes; reduced by positive developments across a number of other classes.

data.standardized_narrative: Gross prior year reserves showed an adverse re-estimation (gross strengthening) of approximately GBP 463.3m (about 18.7% of opening gross reserves), driven by adverse development in several prior underwriting years (notably material one-year development in 2019 and increases in other earlier years) and adverse development in certain financial lines, partially offset by favourable development in other portfolios. The report also notes 2021 catastrophe activity (Hurricane Ida, US winter storms including Uri/Texas and European Floods Bernd) which affected 2021 losses but the prior year deterioration observed in the gross triangle is principally reserve re-estimation rather than newly-named prior-year events.
raw_causal_phrases: Included within net claims incurred is adverse prior year development relating to certain financial lines classes; reduced by positive developments across a number of other classes.

With losses from Hurricane Ida, US winter storms (Uri and Texas) and European Floods (Bernd), Syndicate 2999's net catastrophe loss experience was marginally worse than expectation, albeit manageable, due to the favourable rating environment, combined with a beneficial reinsurance programme, resulting in a net ultimate claims ratio of 62.8% (2020 61.7%).

gross_premium_mix.line_of_business: Fire and other damage to property

data.data_quality_notes: No explicit gross 'movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' line item was present. Prior year development was calculated from the published gross claims development triangle (Note 16). The triangle required mapping rows to column positions; some early/aggregate '2011 and prior' column was excluded per instructions. Per-LOB prior-year movements are not provided in the accounts and have not been inferred. The PYD figure is therefore derived from the gross triangle (calculated) and flagged with confidence 0.8.
